==Biography==
'''Ceos''' is from Tatuí, São Paulo state, Brazil.

== Trivia ==
* Started playing League in 2013.
* Favorite champions are {{ci|Rakan}} and {{ci|Thresh}}.
* Often considered one of the greatests supports in [[CBLOL]]'s history.
* Is the first Brazilian player to play in a tier 1 League outside of Brazil after joining [[Shopify Rebellion]] for the [[LTA North 2025 Split 1|LTA North]].
** He had visa issues in the first split and was replaced by [[Zeyzal]] as an emergency substitute, debuting only in [[LTA North 2025 Split 2|Split 2]].
* His IGN comes from the Greek Titan "Ceos". The inspiration came from his interest in the [[wikipedia:en:Percy Jackson & the Olympians|Percy Jackson book series]].
* His favorite music artist is [[wikipedia:en:Matuê|Matuê]].
* Likes computers and learned programming in school.
* Played lots of sports, including basketball, volleyball, and soccer.
* Watches F1 since he was a kid; his all-time favorite driver is the Brazilian [[wikipedia:en:Gabriel Bortoleto|Gabriel Bortoleto]].
** Stopped watching when he started playing League, started again with the release of [[wikipedia:en:Formula 1: Drive to Survive|Drive to Survive]].
* His KR ID refers to a 4-burner stove, as do the [[Robo]] and [[Tinowns]] IDs in Korea refer to other home appliances.
* [[Croc]]'s old ID in Brazilian soloqueue, '''"ceos chan"''', references him.
* Known for playing {{ci|Xerath}} often in solo queue.
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
